brief: Goldman Sachs' Weekend Macro Call for 5 September 2026 is a call agenda and speaker list, not an argued research note. It states the framing that markets are navigating higher yields, geopolitical uncertainty and a broadening AI investment cycle, then lists six sessions without giving the answers or the reasoning behind them. US Macro asks whether the Fed hikes in September and how high back-end yields can go. Global Rates poses the causes, consequences and path of the global duration sell-off. Commodities covers European natural gas above 70 euros into autumn and winter. Washington and Policy starts the clock on the midterms and what matters most for markets. M&A reports that activity is reaccelerating. Technology previews the next wave of AI alongside the San Francisco Communacopia and TMT conference. Speakers are named per session: Anshul Seghal, George Cole, Ben Readman, Alec Phillips, Carsten Woehrn and Eric Sheridan. Replay is on Marquee. The document states no forecasts, targets or trades, and the only figure it carries is the 70 euro gas reference.
